summary: #1535: trace and mission follow retry behavior

replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged trace and mission follow retry behavior change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in trace and mission follow retry behavior; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: Trace and mission follow viewers now retain their view and retry transient request deadlines rather than immediately exiting with status 2. Deadline retries back off up to 60 seconds; typed daemon outages stop after five continuous minutes. Authorization and validation refusals still exit immediately. Ordinary commands, writes, server APIs, schemas and claim formats are unchanged; scripts depending on immediate timeout exit should account for the new retry period.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by trace and mission follow retry behavior; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by trace and mission follow retry behavior.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
